## Validation

- [ ] `npm run agent:policy`
- [ ] `npm run agent:local-gate`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Truthfulness Review

- [ ] Docs updated where behavior changed
- [ ] User-facing copy reviewed for truthful status/degraded-state messaging
- [ ] `docs/feature-status.md` updated if feature status changed

## Automation

- [ ] Version bumped and release files synced
- [ ] PR is non-draft if it should auto-promote
- [ ] Auto-promote is expected only for same-repo `codex/*` branches targeting `master`
